preview.readerIsPlanetHolder: Your moods and need for comfort can make Bird cautious about how they act around you. They may watch your reactions and change how they enter a situation to prevent tension before anything has even happened, which leaves them less free to be themselves. The pressure on Bird to be what you expect is real, but so is their capacity to choose themselves.
